plan.name: Show shell commands privately on act
plan.summary: Add a page-local Show shell commands toggle on /act, off on every page load, which shows each running step's shell invocations verbatim with their existing kind and start/end times beside its unchanged activity strip; switching it off, losing Access, or replacing or ending a step clears its command display, and late responses cannot restore it. Only GET /act/api/live.json?commands=1 adds per-step commands to the ordinary live envelope after the existing Cloudflare Access signed-token check, with no-store responses: the default private response, every public response and the agent listener remain free of command text, including after private reads warm the cache. Read both existing agent transcript formats incrementally, preserving whole-event handling, overlapping calls, completion-only events and watcher selection, retaining command text only for the bounded recent marks the strip retains, displaying it as inert text and never including tool output or reasoning. Update SPEC.md and README.md to describe the opt-in private view and the unchanged public restriction, citing D-0051, D-0065, D-0116, D-0136, D-0159 and D-0160 on the changed SPEC bullets as applicable. The private retention and display exception to the counts-only live view needs a new recorded decision; whoever merges this plumbing change must record it and add its SPEC citation, since the build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandsKeepExactTextKindsAndTimes
tests.says: The opted-in private live response lists each shell call from either agent exactly as recorded, once, with its public kind and its own start and end, including overlapping and completion-only calls, and excludes other tools, output and reasoning.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandsStayBehindAccess
tests.says: Only a fresh signed owner token and explicit opt-in on the private live route reveal commands; public responses, default private responses, denied requests and the agent listener never reveal them, even after authenticated reads.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandsFollowWholeEventsAndCurrentStep
tests.says: The private list reads only complete new transcript events, updates an invocation when its matching result arrives, remains stable across polls, resets when the transcript is truncated or a newer run replaces it, and drops command text when the step ends.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandsFollowEverySelectedWatcher
tests.says: Commands belong to their own repository, issue and run, and use the same selected watcher and step order as the public activity strips, including concurrent steps and a change of lease holder.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandsRetainOnlyTheStripWindow
tests.says: Private command history is bounded to the public strip's retained marks, and trimming old marks does not attach an old result or command to a different invocation.

tests.name: TestActShellCommandControlStartsOff
tests.says: The authenticated page serves a labelled unchecked Show shell commands control and an initially hidden output area beside each strip; the public page has no command toggle, and loading either page embeds no command text.
